prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a bright snowfield with bare trees under a pale sky, a wooden fence of normal height and a cabin with a standard-size door in the distance, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Iranian woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, richly kohl-lined almond eyes, a deep berry-red lip, thick dark brows, warm olive skin, bold vivid electric-blue hair styled in low bun, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large silver hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on silver chains of different lengths (a silver cube-shaped block, a copper square-sided cowbell, a tin ship's anchor, an iron teardrop-shaped sinker), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a single long brass chain ending in one large faceted diamond drop with a heavy rough bronze a chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre hanging at its end, and a single silver necklace.
